P.name: Fury of the North
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Icebreaker:}} Enemies {{tip|stun|stunned}} by '''Sejuani''' are marked ''Frozen'' for the disable's duration. '''Sejuani's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} against a ''Frozen'' enemy will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at 250 against epic monsters.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains ''Frost Armor'', which lingers for 3 seconds after taking damage from enemy {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|turrets}}, or large {{tip|monsters}}. She restores it after {{pp|12 - (12-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} seconds without taking damage from them.
P.description3: {{sbc|Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}}, {{tip|cripple-immune|cripple immunity}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|10 (+ 75% '''bonus''' armor) '''bonus''' armor}}}}, and {{sti|mr|{{as|10 (+ 75% '''bonus''' magic resistance) '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.

Q.name: Arctic Assault
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Bristle|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he collides with an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
Q.description3: ''Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''

W.name: Winter's Wrath
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After {{fd|0.25}} seconds into the cast time, '''Sejuani''' swings her flail in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} hit, though not through terrain.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 45}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of her '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description2: After the cast time, '''Sejuani''' lashes out with her flail in a line in the same direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 75% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
W.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 85}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 8% of her '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5+5 to 45+85}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30+60}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8+4}}% of her '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description3: '''''Sejuani''' can move during Winter's Wrath's cast time.''

E.name: Permafrost
E.description:
{{sbc|Passive - Frostbrand:}} ''{{ai|Winter's Wrath|Sejuani}}'' and both '''Sejuani's''' and nearby allied {{tip|melee}} champions' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} apply {{tip|stacks}} of ''Frost'' to enemy {{tip|champions}}, medium or large {{tip|monsters}}, and large {{tip|minions}} for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times, though not applying if the target is ''{{ai|Fury of the North|Sejuani|Frozen}}''. Enemies hit by ''Permafrost'' or ''{{ais|Glacial Prison|Sejuani}}'' bola have all of their ''Frost'' stacks consumed. Enemy champions cannot be affected by ''Frost'' for 8 seconds after having it consumed.

'''Sejuani''' can cast ''Permafrost'' against an enemy with 4 stacks.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' hurls a trap at the {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy with 4 stacks of ''Frost'' closest to the cursor, which deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{tt|displaces|Does not apply airborne nor is a knockdown. Applies a move block (forced movement) which can interrupt dashes and other displacements.}} them slightly, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second.

R.name: Glacial Prison
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
R.description2: If the bola travels at least 425 units, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching maximum range or hitting an enemy champion, dealing increased {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds instead. For the same duration, a frost storm is created around the location of the detonation that {{tip|slows}} enemies within by 30% and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area in a smaller radius.
R.description3: After 2 seconds, the storm shatters to deal the increased {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|slow}} them by 80% for 1 second, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
R.description4: The enemy hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm's effects.
